setup.text: A tiny metal object with perfectly regular teeth washes onto the shore.

choices.label: Imagine the people who made it.
Keep it as a warning about unknown worlds.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A smith copies its shape but cannot explain its original purpose.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The object corrodes before a second study can be made.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child writes a tale about a distant workshop.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder cautions against mistaking invention for history.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council discusses how to protect Isola's independence.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Another villager argues that the object alone proves no danger.
